doc.summary: `settledValue` + `pendingNode` — type-safe suspension.
The failing side of `settledValue`: a source can settle on an **exception** instead of a value.
A banner whose accent colour is one variable written by the tone axis.
A progress meter whose dynamic width is emitted through a custom property.
A button whose look is one class and two attributes.
The same geometry without the fill — a second class, not a second component.
Asks for a scroll port. Cannot provide one. Does not pretend to.
The layout that owns the region, and seals.
One row, one machine, one history.
The witness component for level 1.
Context menu shown at the pointer position when a component is right-clicked. Mounted imperatively by the AI overlay controller.

Default floating chat for the session timeline: the captured elements, the recorded event timeline, an instruction box, and the per-section switches that decide what the copied prompt actually carries.
Default bottom-right launcher for the session chat.
Modal that collects an instruction and copies the formatted prompt, with the captured component context and app snapshot, to the clipboard.
The loader shown once a route's guard/resolve chain outruns both `CraftStayMs` and `CraftBlankMs`. Override them globally with `withPendingComponent`, or per route via the route's `pendingComponent`.

doc.summary: A component-scoped service: each client can carry its own currency.
A second component-scoped service, built on the first one. A token that resolves it therefore drags `ClientCurrency` along, and the component DI check reports both when a provider is missing.
The read-only switch below is a real DI dependency of the machine's source-driven save workflow, not a value the component passes in.
Injectable override used by deterministic tests and host integrations.
Storage backend selected by the application through DI.
When true, {@link CraftRouterOutletController} moves keyboard focus to `#main` / `<main>` after a completed navigation (not the initial load).
The service-backed dynamic `import(url)`. Overridable in tests to observe the cache-busting URL {@link retryFailedDynamicImport} computes.

The retry policy `craftLazy` applies to an imperative lazy import. Defaults to the shared attempts/delay loop; override it to tune attempts, back-off, or `shouldRetry` for `craftLazy` loads specifically.
The signal the outlet fills with the active global exception just before it renders the global error component. Runtime-typed loosely; the typed view is exposed by {@link injectCraftGlobalError}.
Route-scoped target consumed by `CraftRouterOutletController`.

Runs inside `startViewTransition`'s callback after Craft signals commit, so the displayed DOM is patched before the callback returns. Templates driven by `craftEffect` otherwise bump an Angular signal asynchronously.
Directly-created injectors remain development-compatible. Application entry points explicitly select their mode when they bootstrap.

The function the outlet uses to bracket a swap in a view transition. The default wraps `document.startViewTransition()`, but falls back to running `cb` directly when the API is missing or the user prefers reduced motion. Overridable in tests to capture the callback deterministically.

The view-transition payload for the current navigation, as a signal the outlet writes and the skeleton/target read (via {@link injectCraftViewTransition}). `null` between/without view-transition navigations.
Whether the outlet should drive `document.startViewTransition()` around its swaps.

Whether the outlet should skip the `'blank'` phase while view transitions are enabled. A blank surface between the previous page and the skeleton breaks the shared-element morph, so routes that declare a `withLoaderViewTransitionImage` payload always skip blank; this token lets `withCraftViewTransitions({ skipBlank })` extend that to every route.
All DOM hooks active in the current component injector.
Token used by custom checkbox-style controls to declare themselves as Craft form checkbox controls.
Token used by custom controls to declare themselves as Craft form value controls. A custom component should provide itself via this token to opt into [craftField] binding.

doc.summary: Nearest runtime boundary used by `CraftFieldDirective`.
Yields the global craft service responsible for clearing persisted `@craft-ts` cache entries from the configured storage persister.

example: ```ts import { GlobalPersisterHandlerService } from '@craft-ts/core'; export class AppComponent { // Consume GlobalPersisterHandlerService inside a craft generator. logout() { // Clear all
craft-ts: cached data from the configured backend. this.persisterHandler.clearAllCache(); } } ```
